# ztna_wildcard (Data Source)

Wildcard data source



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Id of the entry as returned by list/get operations.

### Optional

- `name` (String) Name of the wildcard.

It can only be 64 characters long
and contain unicode text, space, dash, or underscore, or period.

### Read-Only

- `app_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the wildcard is enabled.

If omitted, defaults to false.
- `applications` (Attributes) Discovered Wildcard App oid to name mapping. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--applications))
- `created_time` (String) Created time
- `description` (String) Description
- `enable_policy` (Boolean) Whether policy is enabled for this wildcard.

If omitted, defaults to false.
- `fqdn` (String) The wildcard to match.
- `group` (String) A comma separated list of connector group IDs
- `icmp_allowed` (Boolean) Whether ICMP is allowed for this wildcard.

If omitted, defaults to true.
- `oid` (String) Id of the entry.
- `probe_port` (String) The probing port if the `probe_type` is `tcp_ping`.
- `probe_type` (String) The probing type.

The value can be `tcp_ping`, `icmp_ping`, or omitted.
- `tcp_port` (String) TCP port number(s).

It can be a single port number, multiple port numbers separated by comma,
or a port range like 8000-9000.

If both tcp_port and udp_port are omitted, tcp_port defaults to 443.
- `tfid` (String) The Terraform ID.
- `udp_port` (String) UDP port number(s).

It can be a single port number, multiple port numbers separated by comma,
or a port range like 8000-9000.

If both tcp_port and udp_port are omitted, tcp_port defaults to 443.
- `updated_time` (String) Updated time
- `use_dc_ip` (Boolean) Whether to use datacenter IP for this wildcard.

If omitted, defaults to false.
